async function run(items, op, options) {
	await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency: 4 });
	await mapLimit(items, 4, op);
	await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency: 1 });
	await mapLimit(items, 1, op);
	await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency: 4, nested: { concurrency: 1 } });
	await inOrder(items, op, {
		reason: "Each update needs the preceding result",
	});
}
